Peer Assessment Rubric

  • Apparatus XML Well-Formedness & Validity (4 pts): The <app>, <lem>, and <rdg> elements are syntactically well-formed, correctly nested, and validate against the TEI schema.
  • Sigla Resolution & Header Integrity (3 pts): Every @wit pointer (e.g. #witA) exactly matches an xml:id declared in the <listWit> container.
  • Critical Editorial Rationale (3 pts): The reflection articulates a sophisticated understanding of positive vs. negative apparatus conventions and the epistemic benefits of digital text representation.
